## Safety checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or private IP addresses were added.
- [ ] Risky or externally-visible actions still require explicit approval.
- [ ] No unrestricted model-generated shell execution was introduced.
- [ ] Errors returned to clients do not expose raw provider/internal details.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation matches what is actually implemented.
